basic_details.scholarship_name: Peking University (PKU) Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC High-Level Postgraduate Program)
basic_details.offering_entity: China Scholarship Council (CSC) & Peking University (School of Electronics Engineering and Computer Science - EECS)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Peking University Main Campus (Yanyuan / Haidian District, Beijing, China)
basic_details.major_restrictions: School of Electronics Engineering and Computer Science (EECS), School of Computer Science, and Institute for Artificial Intelligence: Computer Science and Technology, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, and Microelectronics.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~80 to 120 full CSC scholarship seats allocated to Peking University across all postgraduate disciplines annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani graduates represent a prominent cohort under Sino-Pak academic collaboration (~8 to 15 awardees annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2-3 years for Master's; up to 4 years for PhD, renewed annually through CSC Annual Review

nationality_requirements: Non-Chinese citizens in good health holding a valid passport
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: CSC statutory age limits: under 35 years of age for Master's applicants; under 40 years of age for Doctoral applicants.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for Master's; recognized Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related STEM field from an HEC-recognized university with high academic distinction (minimum 80% aggregate or CGPA 3.40 / 4.00; competitive admits typically 3.70+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Peking University evaluates academic excellence rigorously; transcripts must demonstrate high performance in mathematics and core computing coursework.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Rigorous undergraduate training in algorithms, discrete mathematics, computer systems, and programming.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Students in their final undergraduate or master's year can apply; degree completion certificate required before September registration.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior academic publications or strong final-year research thesis significantly enhance competitiveness.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: For English-taught programs: IELTS Academic min 6.5, TOEFL iBT min 90, or institutional English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate. For Chinese-taught programs: HSK Level 6 (min 180 points) required.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None for English-taught graduate streams. Basic Chinese language courses provided.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates apply through the CSC Type B (University Program) using Peking University agency code (10001). Pre-acceptance from a PKU professor is strongly recommended.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another Chinese government or university scholarship simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: 100% tuition waiver covering full postgraduate tuition fees (~CNY 30,000 to CNY 40,000 / year value).

admission_application_fee.details: Peking University international student online application fee of CNY 800 paid online via credit card.

accommodation.details: Free on-campus accommodation in PKU international student dormitories (Zhongguanyuan Global Village or Shaoyuan) in a twin room (Master's) or single room (PhD); or a monthly housing subsidy of CNY 700 (Master's) / CNY 1,000 (PhD) if living off campus.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend provided by CSC: CNY 3,000 / month for Master's students (~USD 420 / month; ~PKR 117,000 / month); CNY 3,500 / month for PhD students (~USD 490 / month; ~PKR 136,500 / month) tax-free.

airfare.details: International flights between Pakistan and Beijing Capital International (PEK) / Daxing (PKX) are self-funded.

visa_fee.details: Chinese Student Visa (X1 Visa) application fee paid to Chinese Visa Application Service Center in Islamabad/Karachi (~PKR 12,000 to 16,000).

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive Medical Insurance Scheme for International Students in China (Ping An Insurance, CNY 800/year value) fully provided by CSC.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized campus canteens (Nongyuan, Yanyuan, Xuanyuan) offer high-quality hot meals for CNY 15 to 25 per meal; covered comfortably from stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to Peking University Library, high-performance computing clusters, and EECS laboratory resources.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Faculty research grants cover travel and registration for students presenting papers at academic conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Beijing Public Transport card provides heavily subsidized subway and bus transit (subway rides start at CNY 3).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single China #1 comprehensive research university: Peking University (PKU, Beijing, China)
participating_institutions: Peking University - School of Computer Science
School of Electronics Engineering and Computer Science (EECS)
National Key Laboratory for Multimedia Information Processing
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 15 global university (QS World #14, THE World #14, US News #31); China's flagship elite university and leader in AI, theoretical computing, and systems.
available_majors: Master / PhD in Computer Science and Technology
Master / PhD in Microelectronics and Solid-State Electronics
Master / PhD in Data Science and Big Data Technology
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Master's: 2 to 3 years; PhD: 4 years full-time.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: 4-year BS (for MS) or MS (for PhD) in CS/STEM with 3.4+ GPA, structured research proposal, 2 recommendation letters from professors, CV, physical examination, and IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 90+ or MOI certificate.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Artificial Intelligence and Computer Vision are intensely competitive; Software Engineering, Systems, and Theoretical Computer Science offer slightly higher selection ratios for well-prepared applicants.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Securing a provisional Acceptance Letter / Endorsement from a PKU EECS professor prior to application submission dramatically elevates your dossier; professors hold significant influence in the CSC nomination ranking.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: PKU International Student Application Portal & CSC Online Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Submit applications on TWO portals: (1) CSC portal (campuschina.org) using PKU Agency Code 10001 (Program Category B); (2) PKU portal (studyatpku.com), upload all documents, and pay the PKU application fee.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (October - December): Review PKU EECS faculty research profiles and contact prospective supervisors to obtain a pre-acceptance letter.
Step 2 (CSC Portal): Register on campuschina.org, select Program Category B, input Agency Code 10001 (Peking University), and complete the CSC form.
Step 3 (PKU Portal): Register on studyatpku.com, fill out the international postgraduate application, and choose Chinese Government Scholarship.
Step 4 (Upload materials): Upload transcripts, degree certificates, study plan (1,500+ words), CV, 2 recommendation letters, Foreigner Physical Examination Form, and police clearance certificate.
Step 5 (By deadline): Pay CNY 800 application fee on the PKU portal and submit before the January deadline.
Step 6 (February - March): Department of Computer Science reviews dossiers and conducts technical video interviews.
Step 7 (April - May): PKU nominates selected candidates to the China Scholarship Council for final approval.
Step 8 (June - July): Official admission packet and JW201 visa form dispatched; apply for Chinese X1 Visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Dual-portal application: Candidate must apply on the CSC portal (Agency Code 10001) AND the PKU admissions portal simultaneously.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors uploaded directly to both portals.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Detailed Statement of Purpose / Research Proposal (over 1,500 words for PhD; over 1,000 words for Master's) in English detailing academic background, research objectives, methodology, and why PKU.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Comprehensive research proposal outlining specific research questions, theoretical framework, methodology, and proposed supervisor alignment.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed academic CV listing education, technical proficiencies, research publications, and capstone projects.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 20-30 minute virtual technical interview via Tencent Meeting / Zoom conducted by the departmental admissions committee evaluating academic background and research motivation.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.5+), TOEFL iBT (90+), or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate. GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Notarized copies of degree and transcripts uploaded; HEC attestation and MOFA attestation recommended for Pakistani credentials.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Notarized Chinese or English translations required for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Dual digital submission via campuschina.org and studyatpku.com.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Notarized copy of Bachelor's degree (for MS) or Master's degree (for PhD) certificate and official English translation.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani applicants submit HEC-attested degree certificates; provisional certificate accepted for final-year students.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete consolidated semester transcripts detailing all completed course units, grades, and grading scale.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure transcript clearly states credit hours and grading scale (CGPA out of 4.0).

required_documents_checklist.specification: Comprehensive research statement (over 1,000 words for MS; over 1,500 words for PhD) in English.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Focus on computational research questions and cite target PKU EECS faculty papers.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Two recommendation letters signed by full professors or associate professors detailing academic competence.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Referees must be professors; include official institutional email and phone number.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Completed official Chinese Foreigner Physical Examination Form with hospital stamp, physician signature, and lab reports (blood tests, chest X-ray).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be completed at an accredited government hospital in Pakistan within 6 months of submission.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official police clearance certificate issued by local police authorities within 6 months.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Obtain police character certificate from local district police office in Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: English Language Proficiency Certificate or MOI
required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS (6.5+), TOEFL (90+), or official Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from university registrar.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Official English MOI letter from Pakistani university registrar is accepted for English-taught degrees.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color copy of valid international passport bio-data page valid for at least 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure passport is valid beyond intended program completion.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: 15 January 2026 (Strict annual CSC Type B deadline)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual intake for September. Strict 15 January deadline; applications on both portals must be finalized before this date.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Academic track record, undergraduate/master's GPA, mathematics and computing grades)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 30% (Quality, depth, and originality of research proposal; prior publications; master's thesis)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Relevant software engineering or research lab experience)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of purpose and institutional alignment with PKU)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 5% (Technical video interview with departmental admissions committee)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: PKU EECS Academic Admissions Committee, PKU Graduate School, and China Scholarship Council Expert Panel.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-tier selection: Peking University faculty sub-committees evaluate and interview candidates, producing a prioritized nomination shortlist. The China Scholarship Council conducts final administrative review and issues formal scholarship approval.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: 3,500+ international graduate applicants across Peking University
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~80 to 120 full CSC scholarship seats awarded university-wide
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_global: ~2% to 3% for full CSC scholarship recipients at PKU
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~4% to 6% among qualified Pakistani STEM applicants
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Undergraduate/Master's degree in CS/SE from premier university (FAST, NUST, LUMS, GIKI, UET, QAU), 1+ published research papers, strong research proposal, pre-acceptance from PKU professor.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of NUST, FAST-NUCES, LUMS, GIKI, and UET Lahore.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Russia, South Korea, United States, Germany, France, Thailand

fake_websites_and_scams: Commercial education recruiters charging large sums claiming guaranteed CSC scholarships at Peking University. CSC applications are strictly free via campuschina.org.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: PKU application fee is CNY 800 paid directly online. CSC portal application is 100% free. Never pay fees to external agents.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Peking University does not work with commercial recruiting agents. Direct personal application is mandatory.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Flight ticket from Pakistan to Beijing: ~PKR 180,000 to 280,000.
Physical exam and police certificate costs in Pakistan: ~PKR 15,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: You must take HSK for all programs. (FACT: English-taught graduate programs require only IELTS/TOEFL/MOI; no Chinese language test required).
CLAIM: A pre-acceptance letter guarantees a scholarship. (FACT: Pre-acceptance is strongly helpful, but final selection is made by the university admissions committee and CSC).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some online blogs state that CSC scholarships pay for international flights. In reality, CSC Type B university scholarships do NOT cover international airfare.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must participate annually in the CSC Comprehensive Annual Review, maintaining good academic standing and passing all coursework.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical presence on campus in Beijing.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reviews and milestone evaluations submitted to the Graduate School and CSC.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: International students may participate in university work-study programs or approved internships with university endorsement, but off-campus commercial employment is restricted.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. International graduates can seek employment in China under post-study work regulations or pursue post-doctoral fellowships.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: No clawback of previously awarded funds; failing the annual review results in suspension or cancellation of the scholarship.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing major requires joint approval from PKU and CSC.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship is granted for the nominal study period; extensions are rarely granted and require special CSC approval.
